newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to facilitate state bank selloffs - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to facilitate state bank selloffs - paper.

text.p: Brazil's highest monetary body is likely to discuss today regulations regarding credit lines created last year to help the restructuring of state banks and facilitate their privatizations, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil said the credit lines were created under a rescue plan for ailing state banks designed to encourage state governments to privatize their banks.

Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj and Minas Gerais state bank Credireal, expected to be privatized this year, and Sao Paulo state bank Banespa, which will be taken over by the federal government, are likely to benefit from the measures, the newspaper said.
